source: BK6 printed p.59 = book5-6.pdf PDF p.65, Scissors, Paper or Stone (wire list, control table, rules, outcome list and To Play), image-read; Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A), tier D game routed as smoke plus the stated rule: every expect is derived by hand from the 41-wire list (programs.json VI-SPS wiresEffective = wiresCorrected = wiresPrinted, no erratum names p.59) and the p.59 rules and outcome list, not from a printed trace. Topology: player 2 pushbuttons drive relay pairs only (4 -> relays 1, 2; 5 -> 3, 4; 6 -> 5, 6, each C-F through its indicator lamp); player 1 pushbuttons drive relay arms only; N.O. contacts route the arm to outLamp1 (player 1 wins), outLamp6 (player 2 wins) or outLamp3 + outLamp4 (tie). The circuit is combinational with no hold path, so a result shows only while both buttons are down. Script: power on; all nine move pairs, player 1 pressing and holding, player 2 pressing 100 ms later (To Play: "Player 1 should move just before player 2 moves since the relays will move after player 2 indicates his move"), the expect taken with both held, then player 2 releasing, then player 1; press and release are separate steps. Hold times, the 100 ms gap and the 200 ms advances before each expect are script choices, not source timing. Derived beyond print: equal moves are a tie (Step 7 notes VI-SPS; closed-world inference), which lamps stay dark in each outcome, relay and indicator-lamp states, nothing moving before player 2 pushes, and the release state (checked once, game 1).

script.cite: BK6 printed p.59 = book5-6.pdf PDF p.65, Scissors, Paper or Stone, smoke: power on, no pushbutton down; rest state unprinted; derived from topology: every pushbutton arm (1Y-6Y) is plus (6Y/6+ and the Y chain); every coil F end (1F-6F) is minus (F chain to 6-); outLamp1, 3, 4, 6 B ends are minus (1B/1-, 3B/4B/4-, 6B/6-); outLamp2 and outLamp5 are unwired. Player 2 drives coils only, each pair C-F through its own indicator lamp: pushbutton 4 (4X) feeds 1C/2C, pushbutton 5 (5X) feeds 3C/4C, pushbutton 6 (6X) feeds 5C/6C. Player 1 drives arms only: pushbutton 1 (1X) feeds 1L, 3H, 6H; pushbutton 2 (2X) feeds 3L, 5H, 2H; pushbutton 3 (3X) feeds 5L, 1H, 4H. N.O. contacts reach the lamps: 1G, 3G, 5G = outLamp1 (1A); 2G, 4G, 6G = outLamp6 (6A); 1K, 3K, 5K = outLamp3 and outLamp4 in parallel (3A/4A). No N.C. contact (J, N, Z) is wired and no relay contact feeds a coil, so there is no hold path; with no pushbutton down no coil C node and no arm is plus, so all six relays rest and all twelve lamps are dark
